name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 leads Chinese models on WeirdML v3
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 leads Chinese models on WeirdML v3
summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 scored 9.2% on WeirdML v3 in Codex CLI, ahead of Kimi K3 and the strongest Chinese model recorded on that agentic benchmark. The provider context window was limited, and a full-context rerun is in progress.

constraints.headline: DHS order bars DeepSeek products from federal civilian agencies
